description: This file declares the FooPlugin class, which implements a plugin interface for the WPEFramework. It includes interface entries, initialization, deinitialization, and event handling methods, as well as registration functions and a method for setting endpoint values.

classes.name: FooPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class in the WPEFramework that implements the IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing registration, initialization, and event handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all plugin-specific handlers or interfaces.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all plugin-specific handlers or interfaces.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Handles setting a value on the endpoint via JSON parameters.

methods.name: event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Triggers an event indicating a value change for a given key.
